summary: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2026 Interim Report (Exhibit 99.1), covering the six months ended June 30, 2026, unaudited and reviewed by Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu. The report, signed by Director and Chairperson Ping Shu on September 22, 2026, contains definitions, corporate information, key financial highlights, management discussion and analysis, corporate governance disclosures, auditor review report, and condensed consolidated interim financial statements. The filing is a routine periodic financial-reporting submission by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US interim quarterly/annual report update, and discloses no transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or structural special-situation event. No special-situation angle to watch.
